item.title: Missouri's basketball scene thrives despite lack of NBA team
item.description: Despite the absence of an NBA franchise for decades, Missouri’s presence on the basketball court is as loud as ever right now. From Columbia to St. Louis, to Cape Girardeau, three Division I programs are putting together seasons that continue the argument that the Show-Me State is, and always has been, a basketball state.

item.title: Why are all the buildings gray: has minimalism gone too far?
item.description: Whether you're taking a drive through a neighborhood or a strip mall in 2026, you might feel a striking sense of dullness and similarity with buildings. What were once bright brand colors or detailed exteriors have now become muted, gray, or other neutral tones. But is the world starting to lose its color?
